user.title: Set up kassistant
user.description: kassistant sits in front of your voice assistant. It remembers what you say and what happens as a result, so it can answer familiar commands itself later on.

data_description.embed_url: Address of your Ollama instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434
data_description.embed_model: Must exist in Ollama. Pull it first with: ollama pull embeddinggemma
data_description.fallback_agent: Receives every request kassistant is not sure about. Usually your LLM agent.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from Ollama. Are the address and model name correct? The model must be pulled with 'ollama pull'.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: kassistant is already set up. Only one instance is supported.

init.title: kassistant
init.description: Start with 'Observe only' and let it run for a few days. Switching to 'Answer by itself' only pays off once enough cards have been collected.

data_description.threshold: How similar a sentence must be to a known card before kassistant acts on its own. Higher means more cautious.
data_description.learn: Records which actions the fallback agent triggers and turns them into new cards.
data_description.learn_delay: Seconds spent waiting for a correction. If you follow up within that time, nothing is learned.

options.shadow: Decide along, but do not execute

seed_failed.title: kassistant could not fill its card box
seed_failed.description:
kassistant fills its card box from Home Assistant's own example sentences, but the attempt failed — usually because the embedding service is unreachable.

Check that Ollama is running at the configured address and that the embedding model is pulled. Until this works kassistant has nothing to look up, so every request goes to your slow fallback agent.

It retries by itself whenever your exposed devices change, or you can run the action **kassistant: Seed the card box**.
